description:
Play your media ad-free on DLNA players in your local network! Play your media ad-free on DLNA players such as Kodi and Smart TVs in your local network! Simply share a supported media link with PlayOnDlna. The app prepares compatible video or audio and streams it directly to your selected player. Supported sources include YouTube, YMusic, PeerTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and media.ccc.de. 🌍 More Choice
Enjoy media from your favorite platforms in one simple app.
🎧 Video and Audio
PlayOnDlna prepares compatible media, cover artwork, and subtitles for your DLNA player.
🎶 Playlists That Just Work
Enjoy continuous playback even when your player has no native playlist support.
📚 Your Media Library
Keep prepared videos and audio ready to play again whenever you like.
📡 Simple
Automatic discovery finds compatible players on your local network. Choose a player and control playback directly from the app.
💝 Ad-Free
Enjoy your media without advertising interruptions.
👐 Transparent and Local
Media is served directly from your Android device over your local network. The publicly available source code lets anyone verify the app's quality, privacy, and security.
If the app serves you well, consider a 🎁 donation to support continued development.
Kodi Setup
To stream media to Kodi, make sure Kodi can be found as a DLNA player in your local network.
1. Go to ⚙ Settings > Services > UPnP DLNA
2. Enable Enable UPnP support
3. Enable Allow remote control via UPnP
❤️ Happy streaming! ❤️
